purpose: Prevent unsigned/malformed local ProgramBench legacy rows from being confused with the active signed T: corpus or future training-eligible data.
policy: Local legacy ProgramBench JSONL is excluded from training by default.
T:/determinex_corpus is the canonical signed corpus root.
Future benchmark rows must be written through the schema-complete signed writer.
Legacy rows require parse repair, schema backfill, provenance recovery, verifier labeling, dedupe, and durable re-signing before promotion.
does_not_prove: Does not repair every old local legacy row; it prevents dirty legacy rows from being mislabeled as training fuel.
